speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information whether he can provide an update on the plan for live-streaming of Parliament proceedings and how this can be implemented in a way that mitigates concerns about its potential impact on the quality and tone of debates.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: All currently available avenues to access Parliamentary proceedings remain.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: These includes attendance in-person from the Strangers’ Gallery, online video clips uploaded within hours of the Sitting and the written records of the Hansard which are also available online.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: These arrangements already give us the full benefits of transparency, accountability and accessibility.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: As I explained in September last year, the Government has agreed to this in view of the global and technological trends which have made online streaming more feasible and enabled legislatures around the world to live-stream their proceedings.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Even as we seek deeper engagement of our citizens through the live-streaming of Parliamentary proceedings, we must preserve the integrity and dignity of Parliament as a forum for serious debate on national issues.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The Member has asked how concerns over the potential impact of live-streaming on the quality and tone of parliamentary debates can be mitigated.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Ultimately, it rests with all Members of this House, present and future, who must uphold the highest standards of conduct and decorum, as we engage in the cut and thrust of parliamentary debate.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just check whether there will be sign language available for the live-stream, as well?

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: In other words, that which has the translations of the vernacular as well.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: So, that will be our starting position in terms of how we make it more accessible for those who may be hearing impaired.
